explanations.text:
4. Every word lives in [one content file](content/essays.ts): the two sections and their essays.


website:
    shows in home the two newest essays and the Catafract banner.
    shows:
        [/essays](app/essays/page.tsx)
        [/throwaway](app/throwaway/page.tsx)
    

[essays have](components/EssayView.tsx):
        title, date, paragraphs, quotes, notes; 
        [links in the text](components/RichText.tsx) become real links.

        translation sections use the designs: "translations mobile" and "translations desktop" from paper design

[draw ](components/Shell.tsx) under the page:
    [wordmark](components/Wordmark.tsx), 
    the side buttons from [the menu list](components/nav-items.ts), 
    and [the categories](components/Categories.tsx) 
   - on a phone → [the slide-in menu](components/MobileHeader.tsx)
   - on the home page only → [the copyright line](components/Colophon.tsx)


if websited visited: 
    [vercel analytics](app/layout.tsx) counts the visit.
